_comment: Game actions in menu order (Esc -> Settings -> Controls). keys: the default keys, up to 'slots' per action, by Godot key name (OS.find_keycode_from_string), matched as physical keys. fixed: keys that always stay on the action and can't be bound elsewhere (Esc also cancels a rebind). pad: the default pad button (one per action, rebindable; names in pad_names), pad_fixed: pad buttons that always stay on the action, stick: the left stick's direction for a move action (not rebindable). The player's own keys are saved under 'controls' in user://settings.json, the pad buttons under 'pad'.
_tools: One 'pick tool N' action per tool in Game.TOOLS, after the actions above; tool_label gets the slot number and the tool's name, tool_keys gives the defaults in slot order.
_pad_names: Pad buttons by their id here (the ids Controls knows) and how the menu shows them, Xbox style.
